title: SHIP: Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2610.21048v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extracting insights from textual data while protecting user privacy is increasingly important. Existing methods produce private insights in diverse forms for different analytical purposes, making their utility difficult to assess and compare. In this work, we formulate differentially private (DP) insights as reusable representations for answering analytical queries, providing a common basis for utility assessment. Answering these queries, however, requires fine-grained details and cross-attribute statistics that existing representations may omit. To capture this information, we introduce Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy (SHIP), which automatically maps queries to attributes, builds a hierarchical hybrid taxonomy, and releases a DP synthetic table for further analysis. translated_title: SHIP：具有隐私保护的结构化与分层洞察
translated_abstract: 从文本数据中提取洞察同时保护用户隐私正变得日益重要。现有方法为不同的分析目的生成形式各异的隐私洞察，使其效用难以评估和比较。在这项工作中，我们将差分隐私（DP）洞察形式化为用于回答分析查询的可重用表示，为效用评估提供了共同基础。然而，回答这些查询需要细粒度的细节和跨属性的统计信息，而现有表示可能会遗漏这些内容。为了捕获这些信息，我们提出了结构化与分层隐私洞察（SHIP），它能够自动将查询映射到属性、构建分层的混合分类体系，并发布差分隐私合成表格以供进一步分析。我们还开发了一个主要基于问答性能和结构化保真度的评估协议。我们的实验表明，SHIP 在相关任务上表现出了强大的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出 SHIP 框架，将差分隐私洞察形式化为可重用表示，通过自动查询-属性映射、分层混合分类体系和差分隐私合成表格，在保护隐私的同时有效回答细粒度的分析查询，并建立了统一的效用评估协议。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SHIP, a framework that formulates differentially private insights as reusable representations—using automatic query-to-attribute mapping, a hierarchical hybrid taxonomy, and a DP synthetic table—to effectively answer fine-grained analytical queries while preserving privacy, along with a unified utility evaluation protocol.
